# Browserbase Documentation

> Browserbase is the Browser Agent Platform: one API key gives your agent everything it needs to browse and interact with the web like a human: Browsers, Fetch, Search, Agent Identity, Functions, and the Model Gateway.

- [Introducing Browserbase](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/introduction.md)
- [Overview](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/getting-started.md)
- [What is Browserbase?](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/what-is-browserbase.md): The complete platform to build and deploy agents that browse and interact with the web like humans.
- [Unblock your agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/identity-and-access.md): Help your browser agent reach protected websites, sign in, and reuse authentication across sessions.
- [Skills](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/quickstarts/skills.md): Give your AI coding agent a browser in one prompt
- [Browserbase Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/quickstarts/agents.md): Run your first browser agent in 1 minute.
- [Stagehand](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/quickstarts/stagehand.md): Build browser agents with Stagehand + Browserbase
- [Start your first session with Playwright](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/quickstarts/playwright.md): Connect Playwright to Browserbase cloud browsers in minutes. Run headless browser automation at scale with session replay and debugging.
- [Start your first session with Puppeteer](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/quickstarts/puppeteer.md): Connect Puppeteer to Browserbase cloud browsers. Run headless Chrome automation at scale with built-in session management and debugging.
- [Start your first session with Selenium](https://docs.browserbase.com/welcome/quickstarts/selenium.md): Connect Selenium WebDriver to Browserbase cloud browsers. Run cross-browser automation at scale with session replay and observability.
- [Browse CLI](https://docs.browserbase.com/integrations/skills/browse-cli.md): Use the Browse CLI to drive browser automation, Browserbase cloud APIs, and Browse.sh skills from AI coding agents.
- [Create a browser session](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/getting-started/create-browser-session.md): Learn how to create and configure browser sessions in Browserbase
- [Using a browser session](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/getting-started/using-browser-session.md): Learn how to connect to and interact with browser sessions
- [Manage a browser session](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/getting-started/manage-browser-session.md): Learn how to manage session termination and inspect completed sessions
- [What is a headless browser?](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/getting-started/what-is-headless-browser.md): A headless browser is a web browser controlled by code, without a GUI. Learn how headless browsers work and how to use them for automation, data extraction, and testing.
- [Managed vs self-hosted](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/getting-started/remote-browser-versus-local-browser.md): Why managed Browserbase sessions usually win over self-hosted Chromium in a VM.
- [Core features](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/core-features/overview.md): The building blocks for powerful browser automation with Browserbase
- [Contexts](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/core-features/contexts.md): Reuse cookies, authentication, and application data across browser sessions.
- [Viewports](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/core-features/viewports.md): Configure viewport sizes for your sessions
- [Metadata](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/core-features/session-metadata.md): Tag and query sessions with custom data
- [Browser extensions](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/core-features/browser-extensions.md): Augment your browser sessions with your own Chrome extensions.
- [Observability](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/observability/observability.md): Debug and monitor your browser sessions with logs, metrics, and real-time inspection
- [Session live view](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/observability/session-live-view.md): An interactive window to display or control a browser session.
- [Session replay](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/observability/session-replay.md): Stream session replays as HLS to embed playback in your own application.
- [Recording downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/observability/recording-downloads.md): Assemble and download session replays as MP4 files, one per page.
- [IP allowlisting](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/security/ip-allowlisting.md): Route Browserbase traffic through your VPN by allowlisting proxies.
- [Allowed Domains](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/security/allowed-domains.md): Restrict session navigation to an allowlist of domains
- [Certificate Validation](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/security/certificate-validation.md): Handle TLS certificate errors in browser sessions
- [Files & screenshots](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/files/overview.md): Download, upload, and capture files from your browser sessions
- [Downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/files/downloads.md): Triggering and retrieving downloaded files
- [Uploads](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/files/uploads.md)
- [Screenshots](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/files/screenshots.md)
- [PDFs](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/files/pdfs.md)
- [Long sessions](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/long-sessions/overview.md): Keep sessions running longer and survive disconnects with keep alive and custom timeouts
- [Keep alive](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/long-sessions/keep-alive.md): Keep sessions alive across disconnects, allowing you to reconnect without ending your session.
- [Timeout](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/long-sessions/timeouts.md): Extend session duration beyond the default timeout period.
- [Dialogs](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/techniques/dialogues.md): Handling browser dialog windows in automated sessions.
- [Timezones](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/techniques/timezones.md): Align the browser timezone with its geolocation.
- [Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/overview.md): Run autonomous browser agents on Browserbase with one API call.
- [How it works](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/how-it-works.md): How Browserbase Agents work: the execution loop, built-in tools, reusable Agents, run lifecycle, and observability.
- [Examples](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/examples.md): Ready-to-use prompts and structured output for deep research, monitoring, and high-scale automation with Agents.
- [Integrating Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/integrate-api-sdk.md): Create and manage Agents, trigger runs, pass variables, and track runs to completion.
- [How to prompt Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/how-to-prompt-agents.md): Write the system prompt, task, and result schema that shape a Browserbase Agent, plus the patterns and gotchas that keep runs reliable.
- [Optimizing Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/optimizing-agents.md): Use the Optimize tool, tune your prompt and schema, and measure Agent quality to make runs faster and more reliable.
- [Pausing and resuming runs](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/pausing-runs.md): Let an Agent pause for input it can't get on its own, then resume the run with a reply.
- [Generate a script](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/generating-scripts.md): Turn a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script with the Optimize tool.
- [Managing files](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/managing-files.md): How Browserbase Agents work with files, and retrieve downloads.
- [Functions](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/overview.md): A Browserbase Function runs your TypeScript code next to a Browserbase browser and exposes it through an API.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/quickstart.md): Build, test, publish, and invoke a Browserbase Function from a local TypeScript project.
- [Write a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/write.md): Define Browserbase Functions, validate parameters, configure browser sessions, and publish multiple handlers.
- [Deploy a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/deploy.md): Publish a Browserbase Function from the CLI or the Playground.
- [Invoke a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/invoke.md): Invoke Browserbase Functions locally or in production, pass parameters, override browser settings, and retrieve results.
- [Use Secrets in Functions](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/secrets.md): Attach Secrets to a Browserbase Function and read them at runtime.
- [Functions limits](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/limits.md): Reference for Browserbase Functions regions, timeouts, build size, parameters, storage, and language support.
- [Secrets](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/secrets/overview.md): Store encrypted credentials and make them available only to the Browserbase Functions that need them.
- [Get started with Secrets](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/secrets/getting-started.md): Create, inspect, update, and delete encrypted Secrets with the Browse CLI.
- [Fetch](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/fetch/overview.md): Lightweight page retrieval as a complement to browser sessions.
- [Search](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/search/overview.md): Fast, token-efficient web search results as a complement to browser sessions.
- [Overview](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/webhooks/overview.md): Receive a signed HTTP request when something happens in Browserbase, instead of polling for it.
- [Registering endpoints](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/webhooks/registering-endpoints.md): Create, list, update, rotate, and delete webhook endpoints with the Browserbase SDK.
- [Verifying deliveries](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/webhooks/verifying-deliveries.md): Confirm a request came from Browserbase before acting on it.
- [Example](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/webhooks/example.md): A complete webhook receiver for Function invocations, from registering the endpoint to handling the event.
- [Agent Identity](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/identity/overview.md)
- [Verified](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/identity/verified-customization.md): Customize Verified sessions with OS configurations
- [Web Bot Auth](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/identity/web-bot-auth.md): Give your browser traffic a verifiable identity with Web Bot Auth. Learn how request signing works and request beta access.
- [Proxies](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/identity/proxies.md): Consistent geolocation and network identity for your browser sessions
- [Website authentication](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/identity/authentication.md): Managing 2FA and other authentication flows.
- [CAPTCHA Solving](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/identity/captcha-solving.md): Browserbase can solve supported CAPTCHA challenges automatically so your sessions can continue.
- [Model Gateway](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/model-gateway/overview.md): Access top LLM providers through your Browserbase API key: one key, one bill, no provider accounts needed.
- [Browser agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/use-cases/agents.md): When to reach for a browser agent, and which Browserbase products solve each use case.
- [Automating form submissions](https://docs.browserbase.com/use-cases/automating-form-submissions.md): Automate form submissions at scale with Browserbase. Handle logins, registrations, data entry, and checkouts using Stagehand or Playwright in reliable cloud browsers.
- [Web data retrieval](https://docs.browserbase.com/use-cases/web-data-retrieval.md): Extract structured data from any website at scale with Browserbase. Use Stagehand or Playwright with Verified, proxy rotation, and CAPTCHA solving.
- [Automated testing](https://docs.browserbase.com/use-cases/building-automated-tests.md): Run reliable end-to-end browser tests at scale with Browserbase. Automate login flows, UI validation, and regression testing using Stagehand or Playwright.
- [Performance optimization](https://docs.browserbase.com/optimizations/latency/speed-optimization.md): Best practices for speeding up your browsers
- [Browser regions](https://docs.browserbase.com/optimizations/latency/multi-region.md): Connect to a browser closest to you for improved performance.
- [Cost optimization](https://docs.browserbase.com/optimizations/cost/cost-optimization.md): Your guide to lowering your browser infrastructure costs
- [Usage tracking](https://docs.browserbase.com/optimizations/cost/measuring-usage.md): Learn how to measure your usage of Browserbase
- [Concurrency management](https://docs.browserbase.com/optimizations/concurrency/overview.md): Session limits and rate controls for concurrent browsers
- [Enterprise security](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/enterprise/security.md): SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA compliance, zero-trust browser isolation, and enterprise-grade security for Browserbase infrastructure.
- [Zero data retention (ZDR)](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/enterprise/zero-data-retention.md): Run Browserbase sessions for regulated workloads without persisting logs, recordings, or replay data.
- [Bring your own storage (BYOS)](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/enterprise/byos-setup-guide.md): Configure your own AWS S3 buckets for storing Browserbase artifacts
- [Plans](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/billing/plans.md): Your guide to Browserbase plans, pricing, and usage limits
- [Billing](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/billing/plan-management.md): Manage your subscription, invoices, and payment details
- [Teams](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/team/roles.md): Manage team members, roles, and project access
- [SSO (single sign-on) with SAML](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/team/sso.md): Learn how to enable SAML 2.0-based Single Sign-On for your Browserbase organization
- [APIs and SDKs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/introduction.md): Choose your favorite way to interact with browser fleets.
- [Overview](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/sdk/overview.md): Faster development for Python and Node.js.
- [Node.js SDK](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/sdk/nodejs.md): All the features and utilities for fast Node.js development with Browserbase.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/sdk/python.md): All the features and utilities for fast Python development with Browserbase.
- [Overview](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/overview.md): Create, connect, and retrieve information from browser sessions.
- [Create a Session](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-session.md)
- [List Sessions](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-sessions.md)
- [Get a Session](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-session.md)
- [Update a Session](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-session.md): Close a Browserbase session by updating its status to REQUEST_RELEASE, or update other mutable session fields.
- [Session Live URLs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-live-urls.md)
- [Session Logs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-logs.md)
- [Get Session Replay](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-replays.md): Returns page metadata for a session replay, including timing information and the URL of each page's HLS playlist.
- [Get Replay Page](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-replay-page.md): Returns an HLS VOD media playlist (.m3u8) for a specific page of a session replay.
- [Create Session Recording Downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-session-recording-downloads.md): Requests one downloadable MP4 per recorded page of a session. Assembly runs asynchronously and every page returns as `PENDING`. Re-posting re-enqueues all pages and retries any that failed. Poll the GET endpoint for per-page status and, on standard (non-BYOS) projects, download URLs.
- [List Session Recording Downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-session-recording-downloads.md): Returns the per-page download status for a session, with a short-lived signed URL for each completed page on standard (non-BYOS) projects.
- [Create Session Uploads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-session-uploads.md)
- [Fetch a Page](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/fetch-a-page.md): Fetch a page and return its content, headers, and metadata.
- [Web Search](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/web-search.md): Perform a web search and return structured results.
- [Run an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/run-an-agent.md): Run a browser agent to complete the `task` by using web search and browser tooling. Optionally pass `agentId` to run a [custom agent](/reference/api/create-an-agent) you've created.
- [Get a Run](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-run.md): Retrieve the current status and details of a run, including its result and associated session information. To fetch the run's messages, use [List Run Messages](/reference/api/list-run-messages).
- [List Runs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-runs.md): List runs across your account. Supports filtering by status, by the agent they reference, and by creation time.
- [List Run Messages](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-run-messages.md): Returns a paginated list of messages produced by a run, in chronological order, with the oldest messages first.
- [Resume a Run](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/resume-a-run.md): Resume a `PAUSED` run with additional input. The reply in `task` is delivered to the agent as the answer to its pause request (the trailing `pause` tool call in the run's messages), and `variables` merge over the run's original variables. Resuming a run that is not paused returns a conflict.
- [Stop a Run](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/stop-a-run.md): Request that an in-progress run stop. The run winds down and transitions to `STOPPED`. Stopping a run that has already finished returns a conflict.
- [Create an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-an-agent.md): Create a reusable agent. An agent defines a `systemPrompt` and `resultSchema` that guide its behavior for every run. Only `name` is required; an agent created with no `systemPrompt` behaves like an unconfigured run.
- [Get an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-an-agent.md): Retrieve an agent by ID.
- [List Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-agents.md): List agents across your account. Supports filtering by creation time.
- [Update an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-an-agent.md): Update an existing agent. Only the fields provided in the body are modified; omitted fields are left unchanged.
- [Delete an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-an-agent.md): Delete an agent. Runs that already referenced this agent are unaffected.
- [List Functions](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-functions.md)
- [Get a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-function.md)
- [Invoke a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/invoke-a-function.md)
- [List Function Secrets](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-function-secrets.md): List secrets attached to a function. Supports filtering by secret creation time. Returns metadata only.
- [Attach a Secret to a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/attach-a-secret-to-a-function.md): Attach a secret to a Function, taking effect on the Function's next invocation. Note: Attaching a secret that is already attached succeeds to support idempotency.
- [Detach a Secret from a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/detach-a-secret-from-a-function.md): Detach a secret from a Function, taking effect on the Function's next invocation. Note: Detaching a secret that is not attached succeeds to support idempotency.
- [List Function Versions](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-function-versions.md)
- [Get a Function Version](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-function-version.md)
- [List Function Builds](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-function-builds.md)
- [Get a Function Build](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-function-build.md)
- [Get Function Build Logs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-function-build-logs.md)
- [Get an Invocation](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-an-invocation.md)
- [Get Invocation Logs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-invocation-logs.md)
- [List Invocations for a Function Version](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-version-invocations.md)
- [Get a Keypair](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-keypair.md)
- [Create a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-secret.md)
- [List Secrets](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-secrets.md): List project secrets. Supports filtering by creation time.
- [Get a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-secret.md)
- [Update a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-secret.md): Replace a secret's value. The name cannot be changed; to rename, create a new secret and delete the old one.
- [Delete a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-secret.md)
- [List Downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-downloads.md): List all downloads for a session with optional filtering and pagination.
- [Get a Download](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-download.md): Get download metadata (Accept: application/json) or file content (Accept: application/octet-stream).
- [Delete a Download](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-download.md): Delete a download file from storage and mark as deleted.
- [Create a Context](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-context.md)
- [Get a Context](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-context.md)
- [Delete a Context](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-context.md)
- [Upload an Extension](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/upload-an-extension.md)
- [Get an Extension](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-an-extension.md)
- [Delete an Extension](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-an-extension.md)
- [Upload a Certificate](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/upload-a-certificate.md)
- [List Certificates](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-certificates.md)
- [Get a Certificate](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-certificate.md)
- [Delete a Certificate](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-certificate.md)
- [Create a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-webhook.md): Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive events for this project. The response includes the signing secret, which is shown only here and when the secret is rotated. Store it before discarding the response. An endpoint may only be registered once per project.
- [List Webhooks](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-webhooks.md): List the project's webhooks, newest first. Signing secrets are not included. Page by passing the previous response's `nextCursor` as `cursor`; a null `nextCursor` means there are no further pages.
- [Get a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-webhook.md): Retrieve a single webhook by ID. The signing secret is not included; it is only ever returned on create and rotate.
- [Update a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-webhook.md): Update a webhook's endpoint URL, its subscribed event types, or both. Omitted fields are left unchanged. `eventTypes` replaces the existing subscription rather than adding to it. The signing secret is unaffected.
- [Delete a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-webhook.md): Delete a webhook. Deliveries stop immediately and the signing secret is retired. Events that occurred before the delete are not replayed if the endpoint is registered again.
- [Rotate a Webhook signing secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/rotate-a-webhook-signing-secret.md): Issue a new signing secret for a webhook. By default the previous secret keeps verifying for 24 hours so a receiver can be updated without dropping deliveries; pass `revokeImmediately` to end that window at once. The new secret is returned only here.
- [List Projects](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-projects.md)
- [Get a Project](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-project.md)
- [Get Project Usage](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-project-usage.md)
